sentences.en: Ladies and gentlemen, we are about to begin our descent.
sentences.zh: 女士们先生们，我们即将开始下降。

sentences.en: William Saroyan was a North American writer of Armenian descent.
sentences.zh: 威廉·萨罗扬是一位具有亚美尼亚血统的北美作家。

sentences.en: The native people of North Africa are of Berber descent.
sentences.zh: 北非土著居民是柏柏尔人后裔。
